subject: Life Skills
title: Insurance: What to Know Before You Need It
description: Learn Insurance: What to Know Before You Need It in one minute.

hook.text: Her apartment flooded. She filed a claim and discovered her renter's insurance did not cover water damage.

buildup.text: Most people buy insurance but never read the policy. The details that matter hide in exclusions, not coverage summaries.

discovery.text: Read the exclusions section first. That is where the policy tells you what it will not pay for.

twist.text: Documenting your belongings before a disaster is crucial. Photos and receipts make claims faster and higher-paying.

climax.text: Walk through your home, video every room and valuable item. Store the video in the cloud. Update it yearly.

punchline.text: Read the exclusions. Film your stuff. Do it today.

quiz.question: Which part of an insurance policy should you read first?
options: The exclusions — what is not covered
